description: What the user is saving toward: target, how much is set aside, progress and any deadline. Name a `goal` to answer "when will I get there?" (add `monthly_contribution` to try a different rate). For a goal they do not have yet, use `what_if`. Answer with the conclusion in words, then offer the link: Bluu shows the curve and lets them drag the amount, which a chat cannot.

monthly_contribution.description: With `goal`: a monthly amount to try. Omit for what they actually save.

space.description: Space name, e.g. "Personal". Omit to cover every space the user has.

name: goals
title: Savings Goals
